			te.role_id,
			te.comp_id,
			t.team_id_upline,
			l.team_level
		FROM upline_prop child
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
			ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
		    AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
		    AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
			AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
			ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
			ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
		    AND child.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
			AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		),
		hierarchy AS (
			SELECT
				company_id,
				activity_date,
                owner_id,
				max(property_name) as property_name,
				max(property_tier) as property_tier,
				max(property_origin) as property_origin,
				max(property_status) as property_status,
				max(translated_status) as translated_status,
				
				max(calls) as calls,
				max(result_call_connected) as result_call_connected,
				
				max(meetings) as meetings,
				max(result_meeting_complete) result_meeting_complete,
				
				max(other_engagement) as other_engagement,
				
				max(activity_blitz) as activity_blitz,
				max(activity_lunch_learn) as activity_lunch_learn,
				max(activity_marketing) as activity_marketing,
				max(activity_property_visit) as activity_property_visit,
				max(activity_event) as activity_event,
				max(activity_discovery_meeting) as activity_discovery_meeting,
				
				
				MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
				MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
				MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
				MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
				MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
                MAX(type) as carrier,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
			FROM upline_prop ro
			GROUP BY ro.owner_id, activity_date, company_id
		)
	SELECT 
		company_id,
		activity_date,
        owner_id,
		max(property_name) as property_name,
		max(property_tier) as property_tier,
		max(property_origin) as property_origin,

		max(result_meeting_complete) result_meeting_complete,
		
		max(other_engagement) as other_engagement,
		
		max(activity_blitz) as activity_blitz,
		max(activity_lunch_learn) as activity_lunch_learn,
		max(activity_marketing) as activity_marketing,
		max(activity_property_visit) as activity_property_visit,
		max(activity_event) as activity_event,
		max(activity_discovery_meeting) as activity_discovery_meeting,
        max(carrier) as carrier,
		
		
		MAX(a.role_id) AS role_id,
		MAX(a.comp_id) AS comp_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
		MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
		MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
		MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
		MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
		MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
		MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
		MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
		MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
	FROM hierarchy a
    
	

	GROUP BY 
		company_id,

		owner_id
;

procedures.contentString:
begin
	delete from master_activity;
INSERT INTO master_activity (
	f_db_id,
	employee_id,
	activity_date,
	changed_activity_date,
	activity_owner,
	activity_type,
	visit_result,
	result_translated,
	result_group,
	visit_verification_feet,
	zip,
	city,
	state,
	db_change_date,
	carrier_system
)
SELECT 
	f.db_id,
	f.eid,
	f.activity_date,
	DATE(f.activity_date),
	f.full_name,
	'Visit',
	f.status,
	k.result_translated,
	k.result_group,
	0,
	REGEXP_SUBSTR(f.postal_code, '^[0-9]{5}'),
	f.city,
	f.state,
	f.date_db_changed,
	'frontier'
FROM leads.frontier_activity f
LEFT JOIN airtable.align_knocking_status k
	ON k.owner = 'frontier' AND k.result = f.status
        ;
        
        -- ------------------------------
        
        
INSERT INTO master_activity (
    cs_db_id, v_db_id, csr_db_id, f_db_id,
    activity_date, changed_activity_date, employee_id, activity_owner, activity_owner_email, 
    address1, address2, city, state, zip, 
    visit_verification_feet,
    activity_type,
    visit_result, company_owner, company_system, result_translated, result_group, 
    carrier_system, db_change_date
)
SELECT 
    NULL, r.db_id, NULL, NULL,
    r.disposition_date, DATE(r.disposition_date),
    COALESCE(
		  e.emp_id,
		  CASE
			WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.rep_email, '.', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
			  THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.rep_email, '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED)
			ELSE NULL
		  END
		),
    coalesce(e.name,
		(select distinct name from airtable.align_employee_alignment
		where employee_id = substring_index( r.rep_email,'.',1) limit 1
        )
	),
    r.rep_email, 
    
    r.street, 
    '', 
    r.city, 
    r.state, 
    r.zip, 
    
    0,
    
    'Visit',
    
    r.status, 
    k.owner, 
    k.system_column, 
    k.result_translated, 
    k.result_group, 
    
    r.carrier_system, 
    r.db_insert_date

FROM leads.vexus_activity r
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(employee_id) AS emp_id, email, MAX(name) AS name 
    FROM airtable.align_employee_alignment 
    GROUP BY email
) e ON nullif(r.rep_email,'') = e.email
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(owner) AS owner,
           MAX(system_column) AS system_column,
           MAX(result_translated) AS result_translated,
           MAX(result_group) AS result_group,
           result
    FROM airtable.align_knocking_status
    GROUP BY result
) k ON k.owner = 'vexus'
    AND k.system_column = 'sales rabbit'
    AND r.status = k.result
;


-- ------------------------------------

INSERT INTO master_activity (
        cs_db_id, v_db_id, csr_db_id, f_db_id,
        activity_date, changed_activity_date, employee_id, activity_owner, activity_owner_email, 
        address1, address2, city, state, zip, 
        visit_verification_feet,
        activity_type,
        visit_result, company_owner, company_system, result_translated, result_group, 
        carrier_system, db_change_date
    )
    SELECT 
        NULL, NULL, r.db_id, null,
        r.date_status_modified,
        date(r.date_status_modified),
        r.employee_id, 
        (SELECT MAX(e.name) FROM airtable.align_employee_alignment e WHERE e.employee_id = r.employee_id),
        r.lead_owner_email, 
        r.address1, r.address2, r.city, r.state, r.zip,
        0,
        'Visit',
        r.status, k.owner, k.system_column, k.result_translated, k.result_group, 
        r.carrier_system, r.date_db_changed
	From sales_rabbit_activity r
    LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(owner) AS owner,
           MAX(system_column) AS system_column,
           MAX(result_translated) AS result_translated,
           MAX(result_group) AS result_group,
           result
    FROM airtable.align_knocking_status
    GROUP BY result
) k ON k.owner = 'chipr'

    ;

procedures.name: initMduActAgEmp
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM reports.ag_mdu_activity_employee_day;

    INSERT INTO reports.ag_mdu_activity_employee_day(
        employee_id,
        activity_date,
        calls,
        activity_unique_calls,
        result_call_connected,
        meetings,
        activity_unique_meetings,
        result_meeting_complete,
        other_engagement,
        activity_blitz,
        activity_lunch_learn,
        activity_marketing,
        activity_property_visit,
        activity_event,
        activity_discovery_meeting,
        role_id,
        comp_id,
        original_team_id,
        original_team_id_owner,
        business_unit,
        team_id_level_1,
        team_id_owner_level_1,
        role_id_level_1,
        comp_id_level_1,
        team_id_level_2,
        team_id_owner_level_2,
        role_id_level_2,
        comp_id_level_2,
        team_id_level_3,
        team_id_owner_level_3,
        role_id_level_3,
        comp_id_level_3
    )
    WITH RECURSIVE upline AS (
        SELECT 
            s.employee_id,
            mo.activity_date,
            mo.activity_type,
            mo.created_by,
            mo.notes,
            mo.outcome,
            mo.cont_hub_id,
            mo.comp_hub_id,
            mo.owner_id,
            mo.hub_id,
            mo.engagement_type,
            mo.updated_at,
            mo.db_id,
            e.team_id AS original_team_id,
            e.role_id,
            e.comp_id,
            t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
            l.business_unit,
            t.team_id,
            t.team_id_owner,
            te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
            te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
            t.team_id_upline,
            l.team_level
        FROM leads.mdu_engagement mo
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
            ON s.crm_id = mo.owner_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
            ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
            ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = e.team_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
            ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 
            child.employee_id,
            child.activity_date,
            child.activity_type,
            child.created_by,
            child.notes,
            child.outcome,
            child.cont_hub_id,
            child.comp_hub_id,
            child.owner_id,
            child.hub_id,
            child.engagement_type,
            child.updated_at,
            child.db_id,
            child.original_team_id,
            child.role_id,
            child.comp_id,
            child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
            child.business_unit,
            t.team_id,
            t.team_id_owner,
            te.role_id,
            te.comp_id,
            t.team_id_upline,
            l.team_level
        FROM upline child
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
            ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
           AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
           AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
            ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
           AND child.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
    ),
    hierarchy AS (
        SELECT
            employee_id,
            activity_date,
            db_id,
            MAX(activity_type) as activity_type,
            MAX(created_by) as created_by,
            MAX(notes) as notes,
            MAX(outcome) as outcome,
            MAX(cont_hub_id) as cont_hub_id,
            MAX(comp_hub_id) as comp_hub_id,
            MAX(owner_id) as owner_id,
            MAX(hub_id) as hub_id,
            MAX(engagement_type) as engagement_type,
            MAX(updated_at) as updated_at,
            MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
            MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
            MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
            MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
            MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
        FROM upline ro
        GROUP BY employee_id, activity_date, db_id
    )
    SELECT
        eng.owner_id,
        -- MAX(eng.employee_id),
        DATE(activity_date) AS activity_date,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Call',1,NULL)) AS calls,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_type = 'Call' THEN comp.hub_id END) AS activity_unique_calls,
        COUNT(IF(outcome ='Connected',1,NULL)) AS result_call_connected,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Meeting',1,NULL)) AS meetings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_type = 'Meeting' THEN comp.hub_id END) AS activity_unique_meetings,
        COUNT(IF(outcome ='Completed',1,NULL)) AS result_meeting_complete,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type NOT IN ('Call','Meeting'),1,NULL)) AS other,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Blitz',1,NULL)) AS activity_blitz,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Lunch & Learn',1,NULL)) AS activity_lunch_learn,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Marketing',1,NULL)) AS activity_marketing,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Property Visit',1,NULL)) AS activity_property_visit,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Event',1,NULL)) AS activity_event,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Discovery Meeting',1,NULL)) AS activity_discovery_meeting,
        MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
        MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
        MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
        MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
        MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
        MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
        MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
        MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
        MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
        MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
        MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
        MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
        MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
        MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
    FROM hierarchy eng
    LEFT JOIN leads.mdu_company comp
        ON comp.hub_id = comp_hub_id
    LEFT JOIN leads.mdu_meeting m
        ON m.eng_hub_id = eng.hub_id
    GROUP BY eng.owner_id, DATE(activity_date);

END

procedures.name: initMduActAgProp
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN

drop table if exists ag_prop;
create temporary table ag_prop
SELECT 
    IFNULL(comp.hub_id, 'no_match') AS company_id,
    date(activity_date) as activity_date,
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    MAX(comp.translated_status) AS translated_status,
    
    count(if(activity_type = 'Call',1,null)) as calls,
    count(if(outcome ='Connected',1,null)) as result_call_connected,
    
    count(if(activity_type = 'Meeting',1,null)) as meetings,
    count(if(outcome ='Completed',1,null)) as result_meeting_complete,
    
    count(if(activity_type not in ( 'Call','Meeting'),1,null)) as other_engagement,
    
    count(if(m.meeting_type ='Blitz',1,null)) as activity_blitz,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Lunch & Learn',1,null)) as activity_lunch_learn,
    count(if(m.meeting_type ='Marketing',1,null)) as activity_marketing,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Property Visit',1,null)) as activity_property_visit,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Event',1,null)) as activity_event,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Discovery Meeting',1,null)) as activity_discovery_meeting,
    IFNULL(comp.owner_id, 'no_owner') AS owner_id,
    max(comp.type) as type
    
FROM mdu_engagement eng
LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
	comp.hub_id = eng.comp_hub_id
left join leads.mdu_meeting m
	on m.eng_hub_id = eng.hub_id


GROUP BY company_id, date(activity_date), owner_id;


drop temporary table if exists ag_deal ;
create temporary table ag_deal as
SELECT 
    comp_hub_id,
    a.owner_id,
    DATE(create_date) AS create_date,
    count(a.hub_id) as deal_count,
    
    
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    MAX(comp.translated_status) AS translated_status
FROM mdu_deals a
LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
	comp.hub_id = a.comp_hub_id

GROUP BY 
    comp_hub_id,
    DATE(create_date),
    owner_id;
	
    
    

drop temporary table if exists deal_1;
create temporary table deal_1
	WITH RECURSIVE upline_deal AS (
		SELECT
				comp_hub_id,
				a.owner_id,
				a.create_date,
				deal_count,
				
				
				property_name,
				a.property_tier,
				a.property_origin,
				a.property_status,
				a.translated_status,
			
				e.team_id AS original_team_id,
				e.role_id,
				e.comp_id,
				t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
				l.business_unit,
				t.team_id,
				t.team_id_owner,
				te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
				te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
				t.team_id_upline,
				l.team_level
				
			FROM ag_deal a
			LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
				comp.hub_id = a.comp_hub_id

			
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
				ON s.crm_id = a.owner_id
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
				ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
				ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
				ON l.team_id = e.team_id
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
				ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

			UNION ALL

			SELECT 
				child.comp_hub_id,
				child.owner_id,
				child.create_date,
				child.deal_count,
				
				child.property_name,
				child.property_tier,
				child.property_origin,
				child.property_status,
				child.translated_status,
				
				child.original_team_id,
				child.role_id,
				child.comp_id,
				child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
				child.business_unit,
				child.team_id,
				child.team_id_owner,
				te.role_id,
				te.comp_id,
				t.team_id_upline,
				l.team_level
			FROM upline_deal child
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
				ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
			   AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
			   AND child.create_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
				ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
				ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
			   AND child.create_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		),
		hierarchy AS (
			SELECT
				comp_hub_id,
				owner_id,
				create_date,
				max(deal_count) as deal_count,
				
				MAX(property_name) AS property_name,
				MAX(property_tier) AS property_tier,
				MAX(property_origin) AS property_origin,
				MAX(property_status) AS property_status,
				MAX(translated_status) AS translated_status,
				
				MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
				MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
				MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
				MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
				MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
			FROM upline_deal ro
			GROUP BY ro.owner_id, create_date,comp_hub_id
		)
	SELECT 
		comp_hub_id,
		a.owner_id,
		date(create_date) as create_date,
		max(deal_count) as deal_count,
		
		MAX(property_name) AS property_name,
		MAX(a.property_tier) AS property_tier,
		MAX(a.property_origin) AS property_origin,
		MAX(a.property_status) AS property_status,
		MAX(a.translated_status) AS translated_status,
		
		MAX(a.role_id) AS role_id,
		MAX(a.comp_id) AS comp_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
		MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
		MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
		MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
		MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
		MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
		MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
		MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
		MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
	FROM hierarchy a
	

	GROUP BY 
		comp_hub_id,
		DATE(create_date),
		owner_id;

    -- -----------------------------------

			e.team_id AS original_team_id,

		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s

		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t

		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l

		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te

			te.comp_id,
			t.team_id_upline,
			l.team_level

		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
			ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline

		    AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
			AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
			ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
			ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
		    AND child.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
			AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		),
		hierarchy AS (
			SELECT
				company_id,
				activity_date,
                owner_id,
				max(property_name) as property_name,
				max(property_tier) as property_tier,
				max(property_origin) as property_origin,
				max(property_status) as property_status,
				max(translated_status) as translated_status,
				
				max(calls) as calls,
				max(result_call_connected) as result_call_connected,

begin

delete from reports.ag_mdu_activity_employee_day where activity_date between range_one and range_two;


    INSERT INTO reports.ag_mdu_activity_employee_day(
        employee_id,
        activity_date,
        calls,
        activity_unique_calls,
        result_call_connected,
        meetings,
        activity_unique_meetings,
        result_meeting_complete,
        other_engagement,
        activity_blitz,
        activity_lunch_learn,
        activity_marketing,
        activity_property_visit,
        activity_event,
        activity_discovery_meeting,
        role_id,
        comp_id,
        original_team_id,
        original_team_id_owner,
        business_unit,
        team_id_level_1,
        team_id_owner_level_1,
        role_id_level_1,
        comp_id_level_1,
        team_id_level_2,
        team_id_owner_level_2,
        role_id_level_2,
        comp_id_level_2,
        team_id_level_3,
        team_id_owner_level_3,
        role_id_level_3,
        comp_id_level_3
    )
    WITH RECURSIVE upline AS (
        SELECT 
            s.employee_id,
            mo.activity_date,
            mo.activity_type,
            mo.created_by,
            mo.notes,
            mo.outcome,
            mo.cont_hub_id,
            mo.comp_hub_id,
            mo.owner_id,
            mo.hub_id,
            mo.engagement_type,
            mo.updated_at,
            mo.db_id,
            e.team_id AS original_team_id,
            e.role_id,
            e.comp_id,
            t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
            l.business_unit,
            t.team_id,
            t.team_id_owner,
            te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
            te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
            t.team_id_upline,
            l.team_level
        FROM leads.mdu_engagement mo
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
            ON s.crm_id = mo.owner_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
            ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
            ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = e.team_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
            ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		where mo.activity_date between range_one and range_two

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 
            child.employee_id,
            child.activity_date,
            child.activity_type,
            child.created_by,
            child.notes,
            child.outcome,
            child.cont_hub_id,
            child.comp_hub_id,
            child.owner_id,
            child.hub_id,
            child.engagement_type,
            child.updated_at,
            child.db_id,
            child.original_team_id,
            child.role_id,
            child.comp_id,
            child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
            child.business_unit,
            t.team_id,
            t.team_id_owner,
            te.role_id,
            te.comp_id,
            t.team_id_upline,
            l.team_level
        FROM upline child
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
            ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
           AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
           AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
            ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
           AND child.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
    ),
    hierarchy AS (
        SELECT
            employee_id,
            activity_date,
            db_id,
            MAX(activity_type) as activity_type,
            MAX(created_by) as created_by,
            MAX(notes) as notes,
            MAX(outcome) as outcome,
            MAX(cont_hub_id) as cont_hub_id,
            MAX(comp_hub_id) as comp_hub_id,
            MAX(owner_id) as owner_id,
            MAX(hub_id) as hub_id,
            MAX(engagement_type) as engagement_type,
            MAX(updated_at) as updated_at,
            MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
            MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
            MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
            MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
            MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
        FROM upline ro
        GROUP BY employee_id, activity_date, db_id
    )
    SELECT
        eng.owner_id,
        -- MAX(eng.employee_id),
        DATE(activity_date) AS activity_date,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Call',1,NULL)) AS calls,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_type = 'Call' THEN comp.hub_id END) AS activity_unique_calls,
        COUNT(IF(outcome ='Connected',1,NULL)) AS result_call_connected,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Meeting',1,NULL)) AS meetings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_type = 'Meeting' THEN comp.hub_id END) AS activity_unique_meetings,
        COUNT(IF(outcome ='Completed',1,NULL)) AS result_meeting_complete,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type NOT IN ('Call','Meeting'),1,NULL)) AS other,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Blitz',1,NULL)) AS activity_blitz,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Lunch & Learn',1,NULL)) AS activity_lunch_learn,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Marketing',1,NULL)) AS activity_marketing,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Property Visit',1,NULL)) AS activity_property_visit,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Event',1,NULL)) AS activity_event,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Discovery Meeting',1,NULL)) AS activity_discovery_meeting,
        MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
        MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
        MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
        MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
        MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
        MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
        MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
        MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
        MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
        MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
        MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
        MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
        MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
        MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
    FROM hierarchy eng
    LEFT JOIN leads.mdu_company comp
        ON comp.hub_id = comp_hub_id
    LEFT JOIN leads.mdu_meeting m
        ON m.eng_hub_id = eng.hub_id
	
    GROUP BY eng.owner_id, DATE(activity_date);

end

procedures.name: updateAirtableRefIds

updateAirtableRefIdsAgP
updateAirtablRefIdsDe
alignDealInsertRefIds
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    -- Create a temporary table for the specific deal
    DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_deal ;
    CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_deal AS
    SELECT * FROM mdu_deals a WHERE a.date_db_insert > update_after and
				(a.upline_ref_id IS NULL
               OR a.seller_ref_id IS NULL
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_1 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_1 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_2 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_2 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_3 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_3 IS NOT NULL)
               );

    -- Recursive CTE to find upline hierarchy
    WITH RECURSIVE upline_ma AS (
        -- Anchor query
        SELECT
            t.db_id,
            t.create_date,
            e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id,
            u.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id,
            u.team_id_upline,
            e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
            u.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
            l.team_level
        FROM tmp_deal t
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
            ON s.crm_id = t.owner_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
            ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
            AND t.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history u 
            ON u.team_id = e.team_id 
            AND t.create_date BETWEEN u.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(u.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l
            ON l.team_id = u.team_id

        UNION ALL

        -- Recursive step: walk up upline hierarchy
        SELECT 
            c.db_id,
            c.create_date,
            c.seller_history_ref_id,
            c.upline_history_ref_id,
            u.team_id_upline,
            e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
            u.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
            l.team_level
        FROM upline_ma c
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history u 
            ON u.team_id = c.team_id_upline 
            AND c.create_date BETWEEN u.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(u.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e
            ON e.employee_id = u.team_id_owner
            AND c.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = c.team_id_upline
    )

    -- Update the deal with resolved upline references
    UPDATE mdu_deals ma
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ro.db_id,

procedures.name: alignDealRefIds
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    -- Create a temporary table for the specific deal
    DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_deal ;
    CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_deal AS
    SELECT * FROM mdu_deals a WHERE a.create_date > date_sub(now(),INTERval 1 year) and
				(a.upline_ref_id IS NULL
               OR a.seller_ref_id IS NULL
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_1 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_1 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_2 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_2 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_3 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_3 IS NOT NULL)
               );

    -- Recursive CTE to find upline hierarchy
    WITH RECURSIVE upline_ma AS (
        -- Anchor query
        SELECT
            t.db_id,
            t.create_date,
            e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id,
            u.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id,
            u.team_id_upline,
            e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
            u.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
            l.team_level
        FROM tmp_deal t
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
            ON s.crm_id = t.owner_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
            ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
            AND t.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history u 
            ON u.team_id = e.team_id 
            AND t.create_date BETWEEN u.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(u.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l
            ON l.team_id = u.team_id

        UNION ALL

        -- Recursive step: walk up upline hierarchy
        SELECT 
            c.db_id,
            c.create_date,
            c.seller_history_ref_id,
            c.upline_history_ref_id,
            u.team_id_upline,
            e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
            u.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
            l.team_level
        FROM upline_ma c
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history u 
            ON u.team_id = c.team_id_upline 
            AND c.create_date BETWEEN u.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(u.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e
            ON e.employee_id = u.team_id_owner
            AND c.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = c.team_id_upline
    )

    -- Update the deal with resolved upline references
    UPDATE mdu_deals ma
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ro.db_id,
            MAX(ro.seller_history_ref_id) AS seller_ref_id,
            MAX(ro.upline_history_ref_id) AS upline_ref_id,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 6 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_6,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 6 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_6,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 5 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_5,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 5 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_5,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 4 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_4,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 4 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_4
        FROM upline_ma ro
        GROUP BY ro.db_id
    ) agg
    ON ma.db_id = agg.db_id
    SET 
        ma.seller_ref_id = agg.seller_ref_id,
        ma.upline_ref_id = agg.upline_ref_id,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_1 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_6,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_1 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_6,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_2 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_5,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_2 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_5,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_3 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_4,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_3 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_4;

    -- Cleanup
    DROP TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_deal;
END

        FROM upline_ma ro

    ) agg
    ON ma.m_id = agg.db_id
    SET

procedures.name: GenerateActivityPropertyDay
procedures.contentString:
begin

SET SESSION sql_mode = REPLACE(@@sql_mode, 'ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY', '');

drop table if exists ag_prop;
create temporary table ag_prop
SELECT 
    IFNULL(comp.hub_id, 'no_match') AS company_id,
    date(activity_date) as activity_date,
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    MAX(comp.translated_status) AS translated_status,
    
    count(if(activity_type = 'Call',1,null)) as calls,
    count(if(outcome ='Connected',1,null)) as result_call_connected,
    
    count(if(activity_type = 'Meeting',1,null)) as meetings,
    count(if(outcome ='Completed',1,null)) as result_meeting_complete,
    
    count(if(activity_type not in ( 'Call','Meeting'),1,null)) as other_engagement,
    
    count(if(m.meeting_type ='Blitz',1,null)) as activity_blitz,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Lunch & Learn',1,null)) as activity_lunch_learn,
    count(if(m.meeting_type ='Marketing',1,null)) as activity_marketing,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Property Visit',1,null)) as activity_property_visit,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Event',1,null)) as activity_event,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Discovery Meeting',1,null)) as activity_discovery_meeting,
    IFNULL(comp.owner_id, 'no_owner') AS owner_id,
    max(comp.type) as type
    
FROM mdu_engagement eng
LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
	comp.hub_id = eng.comp_hub_id
left join leads.mdu_meeting m
	on m.eng_hub_id = eng.hub_id
where activity_date between range_one and range_two

GROUP BY company_id, date(activity_date), owner_id;


drop temporary table if exists ag_deal ;
create temporary table ag_deal as
SELECT 
    comp_hub_id,
    a.owner_id,
    DATE(create_date) AS create_date,
    count(a.hub_id) as deal_count,
    
    
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    MAX(comp.translated_status) AS translated_status
FROM mdu_deals a

LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
	comp.hub_id = a.comp_hub_id
where create_date between range_one and range_two

GROUP BY 
    comp_hub_id,
    DATE(create_date),
    owner_id;
	
    
    

drop temporary table if exists deal_1;
create temporary table deal_1
	WITH RECURSIVE upline_deal AS (
		SELECT
				comp_hub_id,
				a.owner_id,
				a.create_date,
				deal_count,
				
				
				property_name,
				a.property_tier,
				a.property_origin,
				a.property_status,
				a.translated_status,
			
				e.team_id AS original_team_id,
				e.role_id,
				e.comp_id,
				t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
				l.business_unit,
				t.team_id,
				t.team_id_owner,
				te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
				te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
				t.team_id_upline,
				l.team_level
				
			FROM ag_deal a
			LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
				comp.hub_id = a.comp_hub_id

			
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
				ON s.crm_id = a.owner_id
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
				ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
				ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
				ON l.team_id = e.team_id
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
				ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

			UNION ALL

			SELECT 
				child.comp_hub_id,
				child.owner_id,
				child.create_date,
				child.deal_count,
				
				child.property_name,
				child.property_tier,
				child.property_origin,
				child.property_status,
				child.translated_status,
				
				child.original_team_id,
				child.role_id,
				child.comp_id,
				child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
				child.business_unit,
				child.team_id,
				child.team_id_owner,
				te.role_id,
				te.comp_id,
				t.team_id_upline,
				l.team_level
			FROM upline_deal child
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
				ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
			   AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
			   AND child.create_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
				ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
				ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
			   AND child.create_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		),
		hierarchy AS (
			SELECT
				comp_hub_id,
				owner_id,
				create_date,
				max(deal_count) as deal_count,
				
				MAX(property_name) AS property_name,
				MAX(property_tier) AS property_tier,
				MAX(property_origin) AS property_origin,
				MAX(property_status) AS property_status,
				MAX(translated_status) AS translated_status,
				
				MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
				MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
				MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
				MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
				MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
			FROM upline_deal ro
			GROUP BY ro.owner_id, create_date,comp_hub_id
		)
	SELECT 
		comp_hub_id,
		a.owner_id,
		date(create_date) as create_date,
		max(deal_count) as deal_count,
		
		MAX(property_name) AS property_name,
		MAX(a.property_tier) AS property_tier,
		MAX(a.property_origin) AS property_origin,
		MAX(a.property_status) AS property_status,
		MAX(a.translated_status) AS translated_status,
		
		MAX(a.role_id) AS role_id,
		MAX(a.comp_id) AS comp_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
		MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
		MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
		MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
		MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
		MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
		MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
		MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
		MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
	FROM hierarchy a
	

	GROUP BY 
		comp_hub_id,
		DATE(create_date),
		owner_id;
        
drop temporary table if exists deal_2;
create temporary table deal_2 as select * from deal_1;
    -- -----------------------------------
    
    drop temporary table if exists prop_1;
    create temporary table prop_1 
	WITH RECURSIVE upline_prop AS (
		SELECT
			a.company_id,
			a.activity_date,
			a.property_name,
			a.property_tier,
			a.property_origin,
			a.property_status,
			a.translated_status,
			
			a.calls,
			a.result_call_connected,
			
			a.meetings,
			a.result_meeting_complete,
			
			a.other_engagement,
			
			a.activity_blitz,
			a.activity_lunch_learn,
			a.activity_marketing,
			a.activity_property_visit,
			a.activity_event,
			a.activity_discovery_meeting,
			a.owner_id,
            a.type,
			
			e.team_id AS original_team_id,
			e.role_id,
			e.comp_id,
			t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
			l.business_unit,
            
			t.team_id,
			t.team_id_owner,
			te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
			te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
			t.team_id_upline,
			l.team_level
				
		FROM ag_prop a
	

		
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
			ON s.crm_id = a.owner_id
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
			ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
		   AND a.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
			   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
			ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
		   AND a.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
			   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
			ON l.team_id = e.team_id
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
			ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
		   AND a.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
			   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

		UNION ALL

		SELECT 
			child.company_id,
			child.activity_date,
			child.property_name,
			child.property_tier,
			child.property_origin,
			child.property_status,
			child.translated_status,

			child.other_engagement,
			
			child.activity_blitz,
			child.activity_lunch_learn,
			child.activity_marketing,
			child.activity_property_visit,
			child.activity_event,
			child.activity_discovery_meeting,
			child.owner_id,
            child.type,
			
			child.original_team_id,
			child.role_id,
			child.comp_id,
			child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
			child.business_unit,
			child.team_id,
			child.team_id_owner,
			te.role_id,
			te.comp_id,

procedures.name: initMduActAgEmp
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM reports.ag_mdu_activity_employee_day;

    INSERT INTO reports.ag_mdu_activity_employee_day(
        employee_id,
        activity_date,
        calls,
        activity_unique_calls,
        result_call_connected,
        meetings,
        activity_unique_meetings,
        result_meeting_complete,
        other_engagement,
        activity_blitz,
        activity_lunch_learn,
        activity_marketing,
        activity_property_visit,
        activity_event,
        activity_discovery_meeting,
        role_id,
        comp_id,
        original_team_id,
        original_team_id_owner,
        business_unit,
        team_id_level_1,
        team_id_owner_level_1,
        role_id_level_1,
        comp_id_level_1,
        team_id_level_2,
        team_id_owner_level_2,
        role_id_level_2,
        comp_id_level_2,
        team_id_level_3,
        team_id_owner_level_3,
        role_id_level_3,
        comp_id_level_3
    )
    WITH RECURSIVE upline AS (
        SELECT 
            s.employee_id,
            mo.activity_date,
            mo.activity_type,
            mo.created_by,
            mo.notes,
            mo.outcome,
            mo.cont_hub_id,
            mo.comp_hub_id,
            mo.owner_id,
            mo.hub_id,
            mo.engagement_type,
            mo.updated_at,
            mo.db_id,
            e.team_id AS original_team_id,
            e.role_id,
            e.comp_id,
            t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
            l.business_unit,
            t.team_id,
            t.team_id_owner,
            te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
            te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
            t.team_id_upline,
            l.team_level
        FROM leads.mdu_engagement mo
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
            ON s.crm_id = mo.owner_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
            ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
            ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = e.team_id
        LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
            ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
           AND mo.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 
            child.employee_id,
            child.activity_date,
            child.activity_type,
            child.created_by,
            child.notes,
            child.outcome,
            child.cont_hub_id,
            child.comp_hub_id,
            child.owner_id,
            child.hub_id,
            child.engagement_type,
            child.updated_at,
            child.db_id,
            child.original_team_id,
            child.role_id,
            child.comp_id,
            child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
            child.business_unit,
            t.team_id,
            t.team_id_owner,
            te.role_id,
            te.comp_id,
            t.team_id_upline,
            l.team_level
        FROM upline child
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
            ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
           AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
           AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
            ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
        JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
            ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
           AND child.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
               AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
    ),
    hierarchy AS (
        SELECT
            employee_id,
            activity_date,
            db_id,
            MAX(activity_type) as activity_type,
            MAX(created_by) as created_by,
            MAX(notes) as notes,
            MAX(outcome) as outcome,
            MAX(cont_hub_id) as cont_hub_id,
            MAX(comp_hub_id) as comp_hub_id,
            MAX(owner_id) as owner_id,
            MAX(hub_id) as hub_id,
            MAX(engagement_type) as engagement_type,
            MAX(updated_at) as updated_at,
            MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
            MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
            MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
            MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
            MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
            MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
        FROM upline ro
        GROUP BY employee_id, activity_date, db_id
    )
    SELECT
        eng.owner_id,
        -- MAX(eng.employee_id),
        DATE(activity_date) AS activity_date,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Call',1,NULL)) AS calls,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_type = 'Call' THEN comp.hub_id END) AS activity_unique_calls,
        COUNT(IF(outcome ='Connected',1,NULL)) AS result_call_connected,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Meeting',1,NULL)) AS meetings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_type = 'Meeting' THEN comp.hub_id END) AS activity_unique_meetings,
        COUNT(IF(outcome ='Completed',1,NULL)) AS result_meeting_complete,
        COUNT(IF(activity_type NOT IN ('Call','Meeting'),1,NULL)) AS other,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Blitz',1,NULL)) AS activity_blitz,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Lunch & Learn',1,NULL)) AS activity_lunch_learn,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Marketing',1,NULL)) AS activity_marketing,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Property Visit',1,NULL)) AS activity_property_visit,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Event',1,NULL)) AS activity_event,
        COUNT(IF(m.meeting_type ='Discovery Meeting',1,NULL)) AS activity_discovery_meeting,
        MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
        MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
        MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
        MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
        MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
        MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
        MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
        MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
        MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
        MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
        MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
        MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
        MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
        MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
        MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
    FROM hierarchy eng
    LEFT JOIN leads.mdu_company comp
        ON comp.hub_id = comp_hub_id
    LEFT JOIN leads.mdu_meeting m
        ON m.eng_hub_id = eng.hub_id
    GROUP BY eng.owner_id, DATE(activity_date);

END

procedures.name: initMduActAgProp
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN

drop table if exists ag_prop;
create temporary table ag_prop
SELECT 
    IFNULL(comp.hub_id, 'no_match') AS company_id,
    date(activity_date) as activity_date,
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    MAX(comp.translated_status) AS translated_status,
    
    count(if(activity_type = 'Call',1,null)) as calls,
    count(if(outcome ='Connected',1,null)) as result_call_connected,
    
    count(if(activity_type = 'Meeting',1,null)) as meetings,
    count(if(outcome ='Completed',1,null)) as result_meeting_complete,
    
    count(if(activity_type not in ( 'Call','Meeting'),1,null)) as other_engagement,
    
    count(if(m.meeting_type ='Blitz',1,null)) as activity_blitz,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Lunch & Learn',1,null)) as activity_lunch_learn,
    count(if(m.meeting_type ='Marketing',1,null)) as activity_marketing,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Property Visit',1,null)) as activity_property_visit,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Event',1,null)) as activity_event,
    count(if(m.meeting_type  ='Discovery Meeting',1,null)) as activity_discovery_meeting,
    IFNULL(comp.owner_id, 'no_owner') AS owner_id,
    max(comp.type) as type
    
FROM mdu_engagement eng
LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
	comp.hub_id = eng.comp_hub_id
left join leads.mdu_meeting m
	on m.eng_hub_id = eng.hub_id


GROUP BY company_id, date(activity_date), owner_id;


drop temporary table if exists ag_deal ;
create temporary table ag_deal as
SELECT 
    comp_hub_id,
    a.owner_id,
    DATE(create_date) AS create_date,
    count(a.hub_id) as deal_count,
    
    
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    MAX(comp.translated_status) AS translated_status
FROM mdu_deals a
LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
	comp.hub_id = a.comp_hub_id

GROUP BY 
    comp_hub_id,
    DATE(create_date),
    owner_id;
	
    
    

drop temporary table if exists deal_1;
create temporary table deal_1
	WITH RECURSIVE upline_deal AS (
		SELECT
				comp_hub_id,
				a.owner_id,
				a.create_date,
				deal_count,
				
				
				property_name,
				a.property_tier,
				a.property_origin,
				a.property_status,
				a.translated_status,
			
				e.team_id AS original_team_id,
				e.role_id,
				e.comp_id,
				t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
				l.business_unit,
				t.team_id,
				t.team_id_owner,
				te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
				te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
				t.team_id_upline,
				l.team_level
				
			FROM ag_deal a
			LEFT JOIN mdu_company comp ON 
				comp.hub_id = a.comp_hub_id

			
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
				ON s.crm_id = a.owner_id
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
				ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
				ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
				ON l.team_id = e.team_id
			LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
				ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
			   AND a.create_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

			UNION ALL

			SELECT 
				child.comp_hub_id,
				child.owner_id,
				child.create_date,
				child.deal_count,
				
				child.property_name,
				child.property_tier,
				child.property_origin,
				child.property_status,
				child.translated_status,
				
				child.original_team_id,
				child.role_id,
				child.comp_id,
				child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
				child.business_unit,
				child.team_id,
				child.team_id_owner,
				te.role_id,
				te.comp_id,
				t.team_id_upline,
				l.team_level
			FROM upline_deal child
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
				ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
			   AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
			   AND child.create_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
				ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
			JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
				ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
			   AND child.create_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
				   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		),
		hierarchy AS (
			SELECT
				comp_hub_id,
				owner_id,
				create_date,
				max(deal_count) as deal_count,
				
				MAX(property_name) AS property_name,
				MAX(property_tier) AS property_tier,
				MAX(property_origin) AS property_origin,
				MAX(property_status) AS property_status,
				MAX(translated_status) AS translated_status,
				
				MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
				MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
				MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
				MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
				MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
			FROM upline_deal ro
			GROUP BY ro.owner_id, create_date,comp_hub_id
		)
	SELECT 
		comp_hub_id,
		a.owner_id,
		date(create_date) as create_date,
		max(deal_count) as deal_count,
		
		MAX(property_name) AS property_name,
		MAX(a.property_tier) AS property_tier,
		MAX(a.property_origin) AS property_origin,
		MAX(a.property_status) AS property_status,
		MAX(a.translated_status) AS translated_status,
		
		MAX(a.role_id) AS role_id,
		MAX(a.comp_id) AS comp_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
		MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
		MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
		MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
		MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
		MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
		MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
		MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
		MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
	FROM hierarchy a
	

	GROUP BY 
		comp_hub_id,
		DATE(create_date),
		owner_id;
        
drop temporary table if exists deal_2;
create temporary table deal_2 as select * from deal_1;
    -- -----------------------------------
    
    drop temporary table if exists prop_1;
    create temporary table prop_1 
	WITH RECURSIVE upline_prop AS (
		SELECT
			a.company_id,
			a.activity_date,
			a.property_name,
			a.property_tier,
			a.property_origin,
			a.property_status,
			a.translated_status,
			
			a.calls,
			a.result_call_connected,
			
			a.meetings,
			a.result_meeting_complete,
			
			a.other_engagement,
			
			a.activity_blitz,
			a.activity_lunch_learn,
			a.activity_marketing,
			a.activity_property_visit,
			a.activity_event,
			a.activity_discovery_meeting,
			a.owner_id,
            a.type,
			
			e.team_id AS original_team_id,
			e.role_id,
			e.comp_id,
			t.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
			l.business_unit,
            
			t.team_id,
			t.team_id_owner,
			te.role_id AS team_owner_role_id,
			te.comp_id AS team_owner_comp_id,
			t.team_id_upline,
			l.team_level
				
		FROM ag_prop a
	

		
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller s
			ON s.crm_id = a.owner_id
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
			ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id 
		   AND a.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
			   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
			ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
		   AND a.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
			   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
			ON l.team_id = e.team_id
		LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
			ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
		   AND a.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
			   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')

		UNION ALL

		SELECT 
			child.company_id,
			child.activity_date,
			child.property_name,
			child.property_tier,
			child.property_origin,
			child.property_status,
			child.translated_status,
			
			child.calls,
			child.result_call_connected,
			
			child.meetings,
			child.result_meeting_complete,
			
			child.other_engagement,
			
			child.activity_blitz,
			child.activity_lunch_learn,
			child.activity_marketing,
			child.activity_property_visit,
			child.activity_event,
			child.activity_discovery_meeting,
			child.owner_id,
            child.type,
			
			child.original_team_id,
			child.role_id,
			child.comp_id,
			child.team_id_owner AS original_team_id_owner,
			child.business_unit,
			child.team_id,
			child.team_id_owner,
			te.role_id,
			te.comp_id,
			t.team_id_upline,
			l.team_level
		FROM upline_prop child
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
			ON t.team_id <> t.team_id_upline
		    AND t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
		    AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
			AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
			ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
		JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history te
			ON te.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
		    AND child.activity_date BETWEEN te.start_date 
			AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(te.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
		),
		hierarchy AS (
			SELECT
				company_id,
				activity_date,
                owner_id,
				max(property_name) as property_name,
				max(property_tier) as property_tier,
				max(property_origin) as property_origin,
				max(property_status) as property_status,
				max(translated_status) as translated_status,
				
				max(calls) as calls,
				max(result_call_connected) as result_call_connected,
				
				max(meetings) as meetings,
				max(result_meeting_complete) result_meeting_complete,
				
				max(other_engagement) as other_engagement,
				
				max(activity_blitz) as activity_blitz,
				max(activity_lunch_learn) as activity_lunch_learn,
				max(activity_marketing) as activity_marketing,
				max(activity_property_visit) as activity_property_visit,
				max(activity_event) as activity_event,
				max(activity_discovery_meeting) as activity_discovery_meeting,
				
				
				MAX(role_id) AS role_id,
				MAX(comp_id) AS comp_id,
				MAX(original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
				MAX(original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
				MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
                MAX(type) as carrier,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 6 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_1,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 5 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_2,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id END) AS team_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_id_owner END) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_role_id END) AS role_id_level_3,
				MAX(CASE WHEN team_level = 4 THEN ro.team_owner_comp_id END) AS comp_id_level_3
			FROM upline_prop ro
			GROUP BY ro.owner_id, activity_date, company_id
		)
	SELECT 
		company_id,
		activity_date,
        owner_id,
		max(property_name) as property_name,
		max(property_tier) as property_tier,
		max(property_origin) as property_origin,
		max(property_status) as property_status,
		max(translated_status) as translated_status,
		
		max(calls) as calls,
		max(result_call_connected) as result_call_connected,
		
		max(meetings) as meetings,
		max(result_meeting_complete) result_meeting_complete,
		
		max(other_engagement) as other_engagement,
		
		max(activity_blitz) as activity_blitz,
		max(activity_lunch_learn) as activity_lunch_learn,
		max(activity_marketing) as activity_marketing,
		max(activity_property_visit) as activity_property_visit,
		max(activity_event) as activity_event,
		max(activity_discovery_meeting) as activity_discovery_meeting,
        max(carrier) as carrier,
		
		
		MAX(a.role_id) AS role_id,
		MAX(a.comp_id) AS comp_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id) AS original_team_id,
		MAX(a.original_team_id_owner) AS original_team_id_owner,
		MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
		MAX(team_id_level_1) AS team_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_1) AS team_id_owner_level_1,
		MAX(role_id_level_1) AS role_id_level_1,
		MAX(comp_id_level_1) AS comp_id_level_1,
		MAX(team_id_level_2) AS team_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_2) AS team_id_owner_level_2,
		MAX(role_id_level_2) AS role_id_level_2,
		MAX(comp_id_level_2) AS comp_id_level_2,
		MAX(team_id_level_3) AS team_id_level_3,
		MAX(team_id_owner_level_3) AS team_id_owner_level_3,
		MAX(role_id_level_3) AS role_id_level_3,
		MAX(comp_id_level_3) AS comp_id_level_3
	FROM hierarchy a
    
	

	GROUP BY 
		company_id,
		activity_date,
		owner_id
;

drop temporary  table if exists prop_2;
create temporary table prop_2 as select * from prop_1;

    DELETE FROM reports.ag_mdu_activity_property_day;

    company_id,
    activity_date,
    owner_id,

    calls,
    meetings,
    other_engagement,
